name: clementina-sdk
description: Shared development SDK for the Clementina homebrew computer

scripts.build: npm run build -w @clementina/core && npm run build -w @clementina/assets && npm run build -w @clementina/project && npm run build -w @clementina/basic && npm run build -w @clementina/assembler && npm run build -w @clementina/build && npm run build -w @clementina/emulator-client && npm run build -w @clementina/debug && npm run build -w @clementina/basic-lsp && npm run build -w @clementina/cli && npm run build -w @clementina/mcp
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-schemas.mjs --check && npm run validate:specs && npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
